variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: A governing party has left the colony's government. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
